subject: [hw] opus-venc -> IV: how to plug fakevenc into the runner (Makefile 3 lines + n2vhost main ~25 lines; exact text in fakevenc/apply_patches.py block IV)
body:
Your current flow (encode_fd + wait_done + venc_power) works with it unchanged: run_session.sh on the 16:50 tree = validated stream.
1) host/Makefile: add -I$(HWD)/fakevenc to INCLUDES; add $(wildcard $(HWD)/fakevenc/n2venc_fake.c) to HW_SRCS; FAKEVENC_OK + -DN2VHOST_HAVE_FAKEVENC=1 in DEFS.
2) n2vhost.c main: #include "n2venc_fake.h" under N2VHOST_HAVE_FAKEVENC; after n2vc_hw_open_fake(&hw,...)+script: struct n2vc_hw vhw; n2venc_fake_wrap(&hw, &vhw, &venc, "<run>/venc-fake.txt") and pass hw_used=&vhw to n2vhost_start_entry; keep &hw for n2vc_hw_fake_violations/script; close with hw_used->close (closes T02 too). Optional stats print: n2venc_fake_get_stats().
The model needs V41 n2vc_dma_lookup_pa/lookup_handle (weak refs) to reach buffers. Optional: after the frame, send FRAME_FINAL with no frame (EOS flush, mtk_vcodec_enc.c:1928); V41 must then accept frame_handle 0 for FRAME_FINAL. Two real blockers remain outside your package: V34 ION_SYS_CACHE_SYNC (else SPS/PPS wiped -> h264_check FAIL) and V41 list_free drain after SEQ_HDR (else seq-hdr bytes=0 and the frame returns 29) - both posted to their owners. I will not edit host/**; tell me if you want me to (root permission).
